curves.name: Fig. 1 Power Temperature Derating Curve
curves.test_conditions: Series-wide derating curve applying to all types in the 1SMA5913A-1SMA5945A datasheet, including 1SMA5918A. Rated 1.5 W flat up to 75 degC lead temperature, then linear derating to 0 W at 150 degC. Sheet header: Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise specified.

datasheet_identity.title: 1SMA5913A THRU 1SMA5945A - SMA Surface Mount Silicon Zener Diodes (Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology Co., Ltd)

extraction_notes: Target row (1SMA5918A / type code 918A), page 2 Electrical Characteristics, Ta = 25 degC: VZ min 4.84 V / nom 5.1 V / max 5.36 V @ IZT = 73.5 mA; maximum zener impedance ZZT = 4 ohm @ IZT = 73.5 mA; maximum zener impedance ZZK = 350 ohm @ IZK = 1.0 mA; IR = 5 uA max @ VR = 2.0 V; admissible zener current IZM = 294 mA.

Maximum ratings, page 1 (Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise specified): PD = 1500 mW @ Tc = 75 degC; VF = 1.5 V max @ IF = 200 mA; Tstg = -55 to +150 degC; Tj = -55 to +150 degC; typical thermal resistance RthJ-A = 250 degC/W. Package DO-214AC (SMA); polarity: cathode line denotes the cathode end.

Fig.2 Zener Characteristics (Vz 3.3 V to 10 V), page 3, contains the target's 5.1 V I-V curve but as one of ~9 unlabeled family curves crowded between the adjacent 4.7 V and 5.6 V types; curve attribution to 1SMA5918A is not possible, so no points were digitized (omitted rather than invented).
Fig.3 (Vz 12 V to 68 V), Fig.4 Temperature Coefficient (x-axis 10-100 V), and Fig.6 Zener Impedance vs Vz (x-axis 10-100 V) do not cover the target's 5.1 V rating; omitted as not target-specific.

Fig.5 Typical Capacitance is plotted against breakdown voltage on a 10-100 V log axis with an inconsistent (misprinted) y-axis labeling; the 5.1 V target sits at/below the plotted range, so no capacitance value was extracted and specs.capacitance is null.
No table capacitance, no reverse-recovery specification anywhere in the datasheet; both set to null.
